items.8w1_d_0: How much screen time do you have a day?
items.8w1_d_1: About three hours. I usually scroll before bed.
items.8w1_d_2: That's more than me. I should set a limit.
items.8w1_g_0: I usually check messages after school.
items.8w1_g_1: My screen time is longer than my brother's.
items.8w1_g_3: I want a better balance between study and phone time.
items.8w1_copy: This week, I tracked my screen time. I usually spend two hours online after school. My privacy settings are more careful than before. I want a healthy balance, not zero screen time.
items.8w2_d_0: I feel stressed about exams. What should I do?
items.8w2_d_1: You should take short breaks and sleep enough.
items.8w2_d_3: You should balance both. Health comes first.
items.8w2_g_2: You must rest if you are sick.
items.8w2_g_3: I have to finish my homework before dinner.
items.8w2_copy: This month, I learned to manage stress better. I should sleep eight hours every night. I must not skip exercise, even during exams. You should take care of your health first.
items.8w3_d_0: Do you think this old story is true?
items.8w3_d_1: It might be true, but we need more evidence.
items.8w3_d_2: This clue could help us find out.
items.8w3_d_3: Let's check. It could be an interesting project.
items.8w3_g_1: This claim could be true, but we need evidence.
items.8w3_g_2: She may know the answer already.
items.8w3_g_3: The story could be a myth.
items.8w3_copy: Our class investigated an old local legend. The story might be based on a real event. We found a clue that could support the claim. It was uncertain, but the search was fun.
items.8w4_d_0: If we all recycle more, what will happen?
items.8w4_d_1: If we recycle more, we will make less waste.
items.8w4_d_2: If our school uses solar power, we will save money too.
items.8w4_d_3: Let's suggest it to the principal.
items.8w4_g_0: If we use less plastic, we will reduce waste.
items.8w4_g_1: If more people take the bus, traffic will improve.
items.8w4_g_2: If we save energy, our bills will be lower.
items.8w4_g_3: If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.
items.8w4_copy: Our class chose one thing to change this month. If we reduce plastic use, our school will produce less waste. If everyone joins, the change will be bigger. If we start today, results will come soon.
items.8w5_d_0: Who is the person who invented this app?
items.8w5_d_1: She is a student who studied here years ago.
items.8w5_d_2: This is the feature that I use the most.
items.8w5_d_3: It's the tool which helps me the most, too.
items.8w5_g_0: She is the scientist who invented this machine.
items.8w5_g_1: This is the app that helps me study English.
items.8w5_g_2: The tool which he designed is very useful.
items.8w5_g_3: I met the teacher who started this club.
items.8w5_copy: I researched an inventor who solved a real problem. She created a tool that helps people who are blind. The feature which I admire most is its simple design. I want to build something that helps others, too.
items.8w6_d_1: Yes, I have been to Korea once.
items.8w6_d_2: I have never been abroad, but I want to try.
items.8w6_d_3: You should! It was an amazing experience.
items.8w6_g_0: I have never been to Japan.
items.8w6_g_1: Have you ever tried Thai food?
items.8w6_g_2: She has already finished her project.
items.8w6_copy: I interviewed my friend about his experiences. He has visited three countries so far. I have never traveled abroad, but I have big dreams. I hope to have my own journey soon.
items.8w7_d_0: Have you compared the two articles yet?
items.8w7_d_1: Yes, I have. This one is more detailed.
items.8w7_d_2: Which source do you trust more?
items.8w7_d_3: The survey which asked real students feels more reliable.
items.8w7_g_0: This is the survey which most students answered.
items.8w7_g_1: I have already read both articles.
items.8w7_g_2: This source is more reliable than that one.
items.8w7_g_3: The opinion in this article might be one-sided.
items.8w7_copy: I read two articles about the same topic. One source is more detailed than the other. I have already compared their main points. The source which used real data felt more trustworthy.
items.8w8_d_0: Have we finished our problem-solution brief?
items.8w8_d_1: Almost. This is the evidence that supports our idea.
items.8w8_d_2: If we present it clearly, they should understand.
items.8w8_d_3: I'm proud of the evidence we have gathered.
items.8w8_g_0: We have found a solution that could really help.
items.8w8_g_1: If we present it well, people will support us.
items.8w8_g_2: This is the evidence which proves our point.
items.8w8_g_3: We should try this before the semester ends.
items.8w8_copy: This year, I have learned to argue with evidence. We proposed a solution that could reduce our school's waste. If people read our evidence, they should agree with us. I am proud of the argument our team has built.
